summary: Price-drift stays on one product+dates+currency series: among series present at the latest capture, pick the longest history, then cheapest latest rate, then lexicographic room, plan, check-in, check-out, and currency. Snapshot reads order by captured_at, id.
reason: A saved search writes every room/plan with the same timestamp. Picking the last tied row reports drift for an arbitrary product and same-batch ORDER BY captured_at is not deterministic.
validated_outcome: internal/cli and internal/store tests cover longest-history selection, shuffled insert order, and captured_at+id ordering.
